scope: After the required modem PAS boot, bind the exact SERVREG_NOTIF service and issue one state query for resolved domain msm/modem/wlan_pd using the bounded local map endpoint at port 0x4003; accept only its transaction- and endpoint-matched response. Observe QRTR announcements for the modem IPA service 0x31/version1/instance2 and WLFW service 0x45/version1/instance0. Advertise one passive QRTR TFTP endpoint and capture only bounded, sanitized RRQ/WRQ metadata (peer, opcode, path, mode, and options). Send no TFTP response or firmware bytes. No listener registration, RESTART_PD, IPA QMI client request, WLFW client, MSA_INFO, SCM ownership transfer, MSA_READY, WLAN MSA grant, WLAN power, DMA, firmware transfer, radio start, or retry.
